name: court-change
flavor_text: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
effect_text_extend: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
effect_text_simple: Switches single sided field effects from the users side to the targets side and vice versa.
